import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

def task_func(df1, df2):
    """
    Merge two dataframes on 'id' with an outer join, scale numeric features from df1,
    and return the merged dataframe plus a pair plot of the scaled df1 features.
    """
    merged_df = pd.merge(df1.copy(), df2.copy(), on="id", how="outer", suffixes=("", "_df2"))

    numeric_cols = df1.select_dtypes(include="number").columns.tolist()
    numeric_cols = [col for col in numeric_cols if col != "id"]

    pair_plot = None
    if numeric_cols:
        scaler = StandardScaler()
        scaled_values = scaler.fit_transform(df1[numeric_cols])
        scaled_df1 = df1.copy()
        scaled_df1[numeric_cols] = scaled_values

        # Update the merged dataframe with the scaled df1 numeric features
        for col in numeric_cols:
            merged_df[col] = pd.merge(
                df1[["id", col]],
                scaled_df1[["id", col]],
                on="id",
                how="right"
            )[col].values if False else merged_df[col]
        # A simpler and reliable way: replace df1 numeric columns in the merged df
        # by merging the scaled df1 back in and keeping the scaled values.
        scaled_merge = pd.merge(
            scaled_df1[["id"] + numeric_cols],
            df2.copy(),
            on="id",
            how="outer",
            suffixes=("", "_df2")
        )
        merged_df = pd.merge(
            scaled_df1[["id"] + numeric_cols],
            df2.copy(),
            on="id",
            how="outer",
            suffixes=("", "_df2")
        )

        pair_plot = sns.pairplot(scaled_df1[numeric_cols])

    return merged_df, pair_plot
